initial_deadline.resolution: Combined targeted run exceeded the runner total deadline. Split archive and direct ZIP/TLS consumer scopes, raise runner total limit to 300 seconds, retain individual operation deadlines and diagnostics; both scopes subsequently passed. This is not a full release gate.

verification_scope_reason: Actual TLS tarball download verifies strongest supported SHA-512/SHA-256 SRI and raw SHA-256/size provenance, then the existing native installer mounts the Python bundle through canonical boot, executes its tool, unloads and removes it. Real pinned pnpm 11.28.5 pack produces another archive consumed by the native store; original command/output and archive identities are retained. Reject mismatched/weak integrity, incomplete/encoded/non-200/oversized transfer, path traversal, Windows reserved paths, symbolic/hard links/devices/FIFOs, duplicate/case-conflicting entries and roots, ancestor conflicts, directory manifests, missing manifests, file/count limits and a compressed expansion bomb before writing package members. Reverify acquisition records against both original archive bytes and integrity. Existing ZIP/TLS upgrade, rollback, provenance, active-profile refusal, CLI argument and Windows extraction-sharing consumers pass. Native CLI recognizes local .tgz/.tar.gz and refuses missing archives without falling back to pnpm.
legal_adaptation: Native Python package format only; standard npm tar container interoperability does not make JavaScript bundles executable. SRI requires SHA-256 or SHA-512; decompressed headers/PAX bytes are bounded before tarfile parses them, and no extractall or archive links are used. Existing stopped-profile lease and transaction semantics are preserved. Acquisition receipts omit signed URL queries and reverify the exact original tarball.
activation_boundary: Download/unpack/store primitives and local CLI format are complete. Registry metadata-to-artifact identity binding, running-manager transaction composition, default backend and final production/browser/release promotion remain pending.

cleanup.retained: Compact logs/XML, timeout diagnostics, real pnpm pack commands and archive identities; removed task-owned profiles, downloads, compressed/uncompressed archives and compiler/runtime fixtures. Shared pinned Source/toolchains owned through C9.
